name: Tom yum with pork
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai tom yum chicken (4 bowls: 4 cups broth, 3 to 5 chillies, 2 lemongrass, 1/2 lb chicken, 1/2 cup mushrooms, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp roasted chilli paste) and tom yum goong (3 bowls: 4 cups water, 10 to 12 shrimp, 1/2 cup straw mushrooms), Eating Thai Food's tom yum. Per bowl 200 g of water or broth and 70 g of protein; galangal and kaffir lime leaves are left out as inedible or under 3 g.
